title: Stephen Krashen: Language Acquisition and Comprehensible Input
summary: A lecture from the 1980s by linguist Stephen Krashen on how people acquire language. He explains his comprehensible input hypothesis for second-language acquisition.
why: HN language learners cite it as the source of the comprehensible input idea and apply it to vocabulary tools and other learning.

quote.text: I've been pretty much sold on Stephen Krashen's theory of second language acquisition[1][2], which in practice focuses on comprehensible input.
